# `shiftrightunsigned`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->


Bitwise unsigned right shift.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT shiftrightunsigned(4, 1);
```

Result:

```text
2
```

```sql
SELECT 4 >>> 1;
```

Result:

```text
2
```
